definitions.name: Get Outlook Profile
definitions.description: Get Outlook Profile
definitions.documentation: Get Outlook Profile: GET /v1.0/{me|users/userId}. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.documentation: List Outlook Folder Messages: GET /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/mailFolders/{folderId}/messages. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.name: Create Outlook Draft
definitions.description: Create Outlook Draft
definitions.documentation: Create Outlook Draft: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/messages. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation DRAFTS_CREATE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.name: Update Outlook Message
definitions.description: Update Outlook Message
definitions.documentation: Update Outlook Message: PATCH /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/messages/{messageId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation MESSAGES_UPDATE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.name: Delete Outlook Message
definitions.description: Delete Outlook Message
definitions.documentation: Delete Outlook Message: DELETE /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/messages/{messageId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation MESSAGES_DELETE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.name: Send Outlook Draft
definitions.description: Send Outlook Draft
definitions.documentation: Send Outlook Draft: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/messages/{messageId}/send. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation DRAFTS_SEND. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.name: Send Outlook Mail
definitions.description: Send Outlook Mail
definitions.documentation: Send Outlook Mail: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/sendMail. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation MAIL_SEND. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.name: Create Outlook Reply Draft
definitions.description: Create Outlook Reply Draft
definitions.documentation: Create Outlook Reply Draft: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/messages/{messageId}/createReply. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation DRAFTS_CREATE_REPLY. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.name: Create Outlook Forward Draft
definitions.description: Create Outlook Forward Draft
definitions.documentation: Create Outlook Forward Draft: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/messages/{messageId}/createForward. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation DRAFTS_CREATE_FORWARD. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.documentation: List Outlook Attachments: GET /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/messages/{messageId}/attachments. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.name: Get Outlook Attachment
definitions.description: Get Outlook Attachment
definitions.documentation: Get Outlook Attachment: GET /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/messages/{messageId}/attachments/{attachmentId}. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. definitions.name: Create Outlook Mail Folder
definitions.description: Create Outlook Mail Folder
definitions.documentation: Create Outlook Mail Folder: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/mailFolders. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation FOLDERS_CREATE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.name: Create Outlook Child Folder
definitions.description: Create Outlook Child Folder
definitions.documentation: Create Outlook Child Folder: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/mailFolders/{folderId}/childFolders. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation FOLDER_CHILDREN_CREATE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.name: Rename Outlook Mail Folder
definitions.description: Rename Outlook Mail Folder
definitions.documentation: Rename Outlook Mail Folder: PATCH /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/mailFolders/{folderId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation FOLDERS_UPDATE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.documentation: Delete Outlook Mail Folder: DELETE /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/mailFolders/{folderId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation FOLDERS_DELETE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.documentation: List Outlook Master Categories: GET /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/outlook/masterCategories. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.documentation: Create Outlook Master Category: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/outlook/masterCategories. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation CATEGORIES_CREATE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.name: Get Outlook Calendar
definitions.description: Get Outlook Calendar
definitions.documentation: Get Outlook Calendar: GET /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/calendars/{calendarId}. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.name: List Outlook Calendar Events
definitions.description: List Outlook Calendar Events
definitions.documentation: List Outlook Calendar Events: GET /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/calendars/{calendarId}/events. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. definitions.name: Update Outlook Calendar Event
definitions.description: Update Outlook Calendar Event
definitions.documentation: Update Outlook Calendar Event: PATCH /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/events/{eventId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation EVENTS_UPDATE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.name: Delete Outlook Calendar Event
definitions.description: Delete Outlook Calendar Event
definitions.documentation: Delete Outlook Calendar Event: DELETE /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/events/{eventId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation EVENTS_DELETE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.name: Outlook Event accept
definitions.description: Outlook Event accept
definitions.documentation: Outlook Event accept: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/events/{eventId}/accept. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation EVENTS_ACCEPT. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.name: Outlook Event tentativelyAccept
definitions.description: Outlook Event tentativelyAccept
definitions.documentation: Outlook Event tentativelyAccept: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/events/{eventId}/tentativelyAccept. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation EVENTS_TENTATIVELY_ACCEPT. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.description: Outlook Event decline
definitions.documentation: Outlook Event decline: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/events/{eventId}/decline. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation EVENTS_DECLINE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.name: Cancel Outlook Event
definitions.description: Cancel Outlook Event
definitions.documentation: Cancel Outlook Event: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/events/{eventId}/cancel. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation EVENTS_CANCEL. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.name: Get Outlook Free Busy
definitions.description: Get Outlook Free Busy
definitions.documentation: Get Outlook Free Busy: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/calendar/getSchedule. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation.
